basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 50.' and it opens 'Vers. 50. A Domino egressus est sermo. Quia sciebant Abraham prophetam esse, idcirco quod'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 50. A Domino egressus est sermo. Quia sciebant Abraham prophetam esse, idcirco quod Abraham a Domino egressum esse dicunt, sive etiam quia servus Abraham signum a Domino quaesierat eique mox signum datum fuerat, idcirco Deum locutum esse dixerunt.
